name: Alpengarten Kitzbühel
kurzbeschreibung: The botanical Alpenblumengarten at Kitzbüheler Horn showcases over 400 alpine plant species from worldwide high mountains at 1,880 m altitude.
dauer: 1 to 2 hours (in combination with Horn summit approx. 3 hours)
preis: Garden entry free; cable car Hornbahn or panoramic road subject to fees
oeffnungszeiten: Late May to late October daily during cable car operating hours from 08:30 to 17:00
beschreibung:
Overview

The renowned Alpenblumengarten am Kitzbüheler Horn is regarded by botanists and mountain enthusiasts as one of the most beautiful and biodiverse high-alpine gardens in the entire Alps. Perched on a sunny high terrace just below the horn summit at 1,880 meters elevation, the carefully maintained botanical display covers more than 20,000 square meters. Founded by dedicated Tyrolean botanists, the alpine garden is home to over 400 documented plant species from high-mountain ranges around the globe – from the Eastern and Western Alps to the Pyrenees, Caucasus, Himalayas, and South American Andes. Visitors wander through a colorful sea of blooms featuring rare gentians, protected edelweiss, and vibrant alpine roses, accompanied by panoramic views of the Kitzbühel Alps, Wilder Kaiser, and snowy Hohe Tauern.

Route & Requirements

A well-maintained and clearly signposted circular walking trail guides visitors through different alpine vegetation zones in about one hour of walking time (approx. 80 meters of elevation change). The path passes artificial rock screes, dwarf shrub heaths, peat bogs, and biotope ponds. Individual plant signs share details on species origin, medicinal properties, and botanical characteristics. The grounds are designed to replicate the exact natural growing conditions of high-altitude flora. As portions of the path feature natural steps, gravel trails, and gentle inclines, sturdy walking shoes with grippy soles are recommended; the garden is not wheelchair-accessible. After visiting the garden, an easy hike continues to the summit of Kitzbüheler Horn (1,996 m) with its transmission tower and panoramic inn. Access to the botanical display garden is free for all visitors.

Visit & Arrival

The botanical garden is open daily during the summer cable car season from late May to late October from 08:30 to 17:00. The most convenient access is via Hornbahn Kitzbühel gondolas (sections I and II) to the Alpenhaus mountain station. Alternatively, the toll road Kitzbüheler Horn Panoramastraße leads by car nearly up to the garden entrance. Rail passengers arrive at Kitzbühel train station and reach the Hornbahn valley station in approximately ten minutes on foot.

Tips

The most magnificent bloom occurs in early summer during June and July when mountain flowers blossom in full glory. Take advantage of free guided tours led by experienced gardeners, offered daily in summer at 11:00 and 14:00, providing fascinating insights into alpine plant survival strategies.
